title: The Dragon Prince's Ill-Mated Betrothal Manga Ends, Gets 3-Chapter Epilogue
content: Manga artist Sango Sansan 's manga adaptation of Nanaki Ichinose 's The Dragon Prince's Ill-Mated Betrothal light novel series ended with its 32nd chapter, which NTT Solmare 's Comic CMOA manga service published on September 17.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Has a Chance to Be the Next Big Hit
content: Earlier this month, an action fantasy anime by the creator of Sword Art Online made its debut, and it’s already one of the most unique series in recent years. Sword Art Online is one of those 2010s classics that are still relevant to this day.
author: ComicBook

title: Killer Shark in Another World Anime Adaptation Announced
content: An anime adaptation of Killer Shark in Another World manga by Kuboken has been announced. A teaser visual and trailer were also released. Studio Lings is animating the series. Shige Fukase is directing the anime adaptation with Shigeru Murakoshi in charge of the series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Isekai Kuimetsu no Same' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Kuboken 's Isekai Kuimetsu no Same ( Killer Shark in Another World ) on Thursday, revealing staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Netflix’s Solo Leveling Hit With a Major Production Shake-Up Barely Two Episodes In
content: Netflix’s Solo Leveling live-action faces a major staff change just two episodes into filming, potentially affecting the rest of the production. When the project was first announced, it was revealed that Lee Haejun and Kim Byung-seo would co-direct the series.
author: ComicBook

title: kuboken's Killer Shark in Another World Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Kadokawa announced on Friday kuboken 's Killer Shark in Another World ( Isekai Kuimetsu no Same ) manga will get a television anime adaptation. Shige Fukase ( Hamidashi Creative ; episode director for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime , Vinland Saga ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings .
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga revealed three more cast members on Thursday. Previously announced cast members include: • Kōki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya • Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai • Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka • Aya Endō as Saeko Kanaeno • Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi…
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals Special Promo Video
content: The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed on Thursday a new special promotional video. The video previews both the opening and ending theme songs.
author: ANN

title: Arcanadea TV Anime Casts M.A.O, Ai Kakuma
content: The staff for the television anime of Kotobukiya 's Arcanadea bishōjo plastic model series revealed two more cast members on Thursday. Both cast members (character name romanizations below are not confirmed) are reprising their roles from previous works in the franchise.
author: ANN
